summary: AXIA Energia S.A., a Brazilian electric services company, filed a Form 6-K containing an appraisal report for the merger of Retiro Baixo Energética S.A. into AXIA Energia. The appraisal, dated December 31, 2025, was prepared by APSIS Consultoria e Avaliações Ltda. to support the merger under Brazilian Corporate Law. No specific price per share, premium, or consideration was disclosed. The report values Retiro Baixo's shareholders' equity based on book value. The merger structure involves AXIA Energia as the acquirer. Watch for shareholder approval and regulatory clearance in Brazil; the absence of a premium suggests a book-value transaction with minimal arbitrage.
